items.title: European ETFs record €40.8bn in October inflows
items.summary: Morningstar data reported by Investment Week shows exchange-traded funds and commodities in Europe gathered €40.8bn during October.

items.title: UK insurer service reaches four-year high as retention pressures mount
items.summary: Gracechurch and BIBA UK Insurers Monitor results show market average Net Promoter Scores rising to +25, even as expected business retention slips to 88%.

items.title: London Engineering Group publishes three new construction defects clauses
items.summary: The London Engineering Group has released three model insurance clauses designed to clarify coverage limits following recent court judgments.

items.title: Brokers voice doubts over future senior claims expertise in the London market
items.summary: Research from Tokio Marine Kiln reveals that over a quarter of brokers lack confidence in long-term senior claims capabilities.

items.title: Gallagher names Rawden Leigh Head of Retail for Financial Institutions practice
items.summary: The former Marsh Managing Director joins Gallagher in London to lead client propositions across the UK and Europe.

items.title: Underwriters must embrace geopolitics to avoid market stagnation, says Lloyd’s Turk
items.summary: Rachel Turk urged insurers to focus on risk awareness rather than exclusion during an AM Best briefing in London.
